bio.text: André Carson represents Indiana's 7th District in the U.S. House and serves on the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.
Before taking office he served on the Indianapolis City-County Council and worked in law enforcement and for the Indiana Department of Homeland Security.

A native of Indianapolis, he graduated from Arsenal Tech High School and holds a bachelor's degree from Concordia University Wisconsin and a master's in business management from Indiana Wesleyan University.
